notes.title: 2024 RECAP
notes.notes:
2024 RECAP

With 2024 coming to a conclusion, I'd like to take a moment to update
everyone of how it went for the Studio.

Three games were released.
Raey
White Bridge
Castle Dark

White Bridge was an incredibly ambitious game for the studio and I was
thrilled to see it received by everyone so well.
This was the style of game I had wanted to create for years and finally
decided it was time to make it happen.

Castle Dark embodies another concept I've always wanted to make which is
an action RPG with crafting and trade skill elements. 
The majority of 2024 was spent making games out of the ordinary for 
Wolfs Moon Studios but you've all stuck with me for it and for that
I am truly thankful.

Stay tuned for 2025.

Wolfs Moon Studios

notes.title: Verdungo sells over 1000 copies
notes.notes:
Verdungo sells over 1000 copies and this is a major milestone for the studio!

As you all know I am a single developer so for Verdungo to reach this level of sales is extremely satisfying to me and warms my heart that it has been received so positively!

Thank you all!!

Shane
Wolfs Moon Studios

notes.title: 7th Wolfs Moon Title Seventh Star Released
notes.notes:
The war of the wolves continues to wage on for decades as the North and South struggle for power.
A young female warrior named Quarry fights for the southern kingdom of Rinehart.
She attempts to unite the southern hemisphere while uncovering her past.
What will she discover about the Seventh Star as she digs deeper? The people need hope and perhaps Quarry is exactly the person
to bring them it.

Players will enjoy a vibrant soundtrack, massive variety of monsters to encounter, an enjoyable story and engaging combat.
The option for crafting & alchemy is available for players who enjoy it in Seventh Star.
Similar to other Wolfs Moon Studios titles- players can expect many hours of game play and appearances from old and familiar faces from previous stories.
Single player RPG.

*Hundreds of monster types
*Unique Crafting/Alchemy recipes
*Engaging combat with multiple elements/status effects
*Over 20 hours of gameplay

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2240660/Seventh_Star/

Verdungo receives official Positive Steam Rating!

Wolfs Moon Studios

notes.title: Happy Holidays and Thank you All!
notes.notes:
Since Launch: Verdungo has done very well and I just wanted to thank all of you for your support
and to enjoy your holidays with friends & family!

We are closing in on getting a steam rating ( requires 10 reviews total)
and overall feelings about the game have been positive and supportive!

I know it's a pain in the butt but if you enjoyed the game, please write up a sentence or two for a review so that others can see your experience!!

As always if you need help I'm accessible in the forums!


Thank you everyone! I truly appreciate it!

Wolfs Moon Studios
